notes: Two teams of avatars playing soccer in a stadium is Sports on space-bounded, the marked pitch perimeter with play contained inside it, and Field Sport supplies the touchline reset, the kickoff spot, the goal mouths and the pitch markings. The prompt names the stadium and the answers confirm a modern floodlit one, so I added barrier-perimeter and spectator-bleachers; the stepped seating is the only elevation in the build, so it routes P0 with tiered and nothing overhangs. The answers read 'vs' as player-versus-player teams, which is gameplay rather than layout and changes nothing about the space beyond needing two balanced team ends. No crowd was mentioned, so I dressed the stands without populating them, and the Roblox-avatar look is a styling instruction rather than a layout feature.
